findings.label: Unopposed lean-mass loss treated as success
findings.why: Longevity use is why this room exists. Skip protein and lifting, or call muscle loss a success, and the station fail-closes.

findings.label: Biliary colic after rapid loss
findings.why: Do not increase the dose. Image. Fever, jaundice, or relentless pain is ED — sending them is allowed. Continue is not.

findings.label: Pancreatitis pattern
findings.why: ED same visit. Hold the drug. Antiemetic and home is an idiot move. Prior cholecystectomy does not exclude this.

findings.label: Delayed emptying plus volume depletion
findings.why: Hold. Fluids and creatinine. Not a prokinetic and continue.

findings.label: New depression with passive suicidal thinking
findings.why: Ask plan and intent. Continue as if this were a dose visit fail-closes this station.

findings.label: Sudden monocular field cut (NAION until proven otherwise)
findings.why: Same-day eye or ED. Not dry eye. Not optometrist next week. Do not drive.

findings.label: Grey-market vial with febrile injection site
findings.why: This is not Ozempic. Stop the vial. Treat the infection. Do not dose-adjust a telegram peptide.

findings.label: Neck lump, hoarseness, unclarified family thyroid cancer
findings.why: Boxed warning. Stop pending workup. Do not assume papillary. Do not review in three months.
